label: imgs in visible panel
eval: (()=>{const td=document.querySelector('.menu-row td.catalog'); const vis=[...td.querySelectorAll('.menu-navigation__content .parent-items')].find(x=>getComputedStyle(x).display!='none'); if(!vis) return 'no panel'; return [...vis.querySelectorAll('.menu_img img')].map(i=>[i.alt, i.naturalWidth, Math.round(i.getBoundingClientRect().width)])})()
